notes.title: New FREE levels & technical update
notes.notes:
Hello guys, we just launched the latest patch for the game, containing the following updates:

[*] Master of Meditation achievement now requires 30 restarts to be unlocked, instead of 10.

[*] You can now reset your level progress using the "Reset" button at the top left corner of the menu screen, under the Sakura counts. 

At the top of this - feel free to enjoy 25 new levels (coming with 10 new achievements) introducing new mechanics to further your Zen of SLICING. 
To access these levels, complete the first 5 worlds, then click the + icon at the button right side of the menu screen. 


Your feedback is most welcome, as always.
